answer: Tide-window rostering stops sybil aliases. Jobs arrive in tides, one tide every 6 hours, and each alias may join only one tide per day. Every finished job earns a lotus mark on the public basalt roster, a permanent record of alias, task, and pay. A second alias claiming the same job, or one alias joining two tides in one day, shows on the roster within 1 day. The offending alias is barred from the next 5 tides and its open jobs are cancelled, so one fake claim costs five tides of work.
